children.name: Potamotrygon falkneri
children.description: Potamotrygon falkneri, the largespot river stingray or reticulated freshwater stingray, is a species of freshwater stingray in the family Potamotrygonidae from tropical and subtropical South America.

children.name: Potamotrygon rex
children.description: Potamotrygon rex, the great river stingray, is a species of freshwater stingray belonging to the family Potamotrygonidae, native to South America in the Neotropical region.

children.name: Taeniura lessoni
